How did Summit Travel Partners do on DFW.text: Q3 2026: AA revenue $297,931, AA share 53.5%, fair share 37.6%, share gap 15.9 pts, YoY vs Q3 2025 +34.6116%. Q3 2025: AA revenue $221,326, AA share 46.3%, fair share 37.7%, share gap 8.6 pts. Ahead of fair share: Ahead in both quarters. Source: ask_metrics (aa_demo.gold.sales_metrics).

sql:
WITH quarters AS (
  SELECT quarter, ROUND(MEASURE(aa_revenue)) AS aa_revenue, ROUND(MEASURE(aa_share) * 100, 1) AS aa_share_pct,
         ROUND(MEASURE(fair_share) * 100, 1) AS fair_share_pct, ROUND(MEASURE(share_gap_pts), 1) AS share_gap_pts,
         MEASURE(aa_revenue) AS aa_revenue_raw,
         MEASURE(aa_share) AS aa_share_raw,
         MEASURE(fair_share) AS fair_share_raw,
         CASE WHEN MEASURE(aa_share) > MEASURE(fair_share) THEN 'Ahead' ELSE 'Behind' END AS ahead_of_fair_share
  FROM aa_demo.gold.sales_metrics
  WHERE agency = 'Summit Travel Partners' AND market = 'DFW-ORD' AND quarter IN ('Q3 2025', 'Q3 2026')
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT q1.quarter,
       q1.aa_revenue,
       q1.aa_share_pct,
       q1.fair_share_pct,
       q1.share_gap_pts,
       q1.ahead_of_fair_share,
       q1.aa_revenue_raw,
       q1.aa_share_raw,
       q1.fair_share_raw,
       try_divide((q1.aa_revenue_raw - q2.aa_revenue_raw),NULLIF(q2.aa_revenue_raw, 0)) * 100 AS yoy_revenue_pct
FROM quarters q1
LEFT JOIN quarters q2 ON q1.quarter = 'Q3 2026' AND q2.quarter = 'Q3 2025'
ORDER BY q1.quarter

What does Summit Travel Partners' agreem.text:
"5.1 If Agency's Carrier revenue share across the Covered Markets falls below 45% for two consecutive calendar quarters, Carrier may review the Agency's tier and reduce it by one tier for the following year." (summit-travel-partners.md, page 2)

Has that happened: No. AA share by quarter for Summit Travel Partners from Q1 2025 to Q3 2026 ranged from 45.1% to 52.6%, and there were no instances where two consecutive quarters had AA share below 45%. (ask_metrics: aa_demo.gold.sales_metrics)

Could not verify: whether Carrier actually reviewed or reduced Summit's tier under this clause; would need internal tier-change records or contract amendment history.
sql:
WITH q AS (
  SELECT quarter, MEASURE(aa_share) AS aa_share
  FROM aa_demo.gold.sales_metrics
  WHERE agency = 'Summit Travel Partners' AND sales_month >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND sales_month <= DATE '2026-09-30'
  GROUP BY ALL
  ORDER BY quarter ASC
)
SELECT quarter, ROUND(aa_share * 100, 1) AS aa_share_pct,
       CASE WHEN aa_share < 0.45 AND LAG(aa_share) OVER (ORDER BY quarter ASC) < 0.45 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS two_consecutive_below_45
FROM q

sql: WITH rev AS (SELECT agency, ROUND(MEASURE(aa_revenue)) AS aa_revenue_now, ROUND(MEASURE(aa_revenue_prior_year)) AS aa_revenue_prior, ROUND(MEASURE(yoy_revenue_pct) * 100, 1) AS delta_pct FROM aa_demo.gold.sales_metrics WHERE sales_month = DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY ALL HAVING delta_pct < -10), pace AS (SELECT agency_id, ytd_revenue, revenue_goal_usd, ytd_goal, pace_pct FROM aa_demo.gold.agency_pace WHERE sales_month = DATE '2026-09-01' AND goal_year = 2026 AND pace_pct < 90) SELECT a.agency_name, r.aa_revenue_now, r.aa_revenue_prior, r.delta_pct, p.ytd_revenue, p.revenue_goal_usd, p.ytd_goal, p.pace_pct FROM rev r JOIN aa_demo.gold.dim_agency a ON r.agency = a.agency_name JOIN pace p ON a.agency_id = p.agency_id ORDER BY r.delta_pct
